TOUGHNESS.name: TOUGHNESS
TOUGHNESS.desc: More health: 10 more for every step.

ENDURANCE.name: ENDURANCE
ENDURANCE.desc: More stamina: every step is one more dash before the bar runs dry.

SWIFTNESS.name: SWIFTNESS
SWIFTNESS.desc: Runs and sprints faster: every step adds 6%.

FOCUS.name: FOCUS
FOCUS.desc: More mana to charge a cast with: 20 more for every step.

QUICK_HANDS.name: QUICK HANDS
QUICK_HANDS.desc: A shorter wait between casts: every step takes off 6%.

SCAVENGER.name: SCAVENGER
SCAVENGER.desc: More gold from everything found in a raid: every step adds 15%.
